Container.Name: openGym-MCP
Container.Overview: Standalone openGym MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Mount the existing openGym API data directory read-only; protect the /mcp endpoint with an API key. NOT an OAuth server.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP port
Config.Description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint is /mcp; /healthz is a gateway health check.

Config.Name: openGym API data directory
Config.Description: HOST path containing db.json and state-*.json. Replace with your actual API volume host path.

Config.Name: MCP API key
Config.Description: REQUIRED: long random secret; passed as Authorization: Bearer TOKEN (or X-API-Key).

Config.Name: openGym profile ID
Config.Description: Optional for single-profile installations; otherwise users[].id in db.json.
